requests.title: Draft: [WID-123] 할인_적용
requests.body:
## What does this MR do and why?
<!-- Describe the change and the problem it solves. -->
Adds a percentage discount to pricing so a 0-100% discount can be applied to an order subtotal, and out-of-range percentages are rejected (WID-123).

- `src/discount.py`: new `apply_discount(items, percent)` returns `subtotal(items)` reduced by `percent`; a percent outside 0-100 raises `ValueError`.
- `tests/test_discount.py`: covers the acceptance criteria (10% off a subtotal of 20 gives 18; 120% raises `ValueError`).
- `docs/discount.md`: documents `apply_discount` and its accepted 0-100 range.

Synced with `origin/develop` at `02872156ce5d8ad66539dae128b70abea79def9a` through a merge commit; no conflicts. The half-up cent rounding change (`src/rounding.py`) arrived from `develop` and is not part of this MR's work. All WID-123 acceptance criteria are covered; no remaining scope.

## Related issues
<!-- Jira key -->
WID-123

## How to set up and validate locally
<!-- Commands and results. -->
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`: passed (4 tests: discount, pricing, and rounding from `develop`) on the pushed commit `705ddf8`.
- `python3 -c "from src.discount import apply_discount; from src.rounding import to_cents; print(to_cents(apply_discount([(10, 2)], 10)))"`: passed, prints `1800`, so the new discount and the merged rounding helper work together.

## MR acceptance checklist
- [x] Tests added or updated
- [x] Documentation updated if needed
